paragraphs: Nimos, brother of Rabbi Yehoshua HaGarsi. Yehoshua was Rabbi Akiva’s attendant.[^1]

Mentioned in [Tosefta Makhshirin, chapter 3](https://www.sefaria.org/Tosefta_Makhshirin.3.8), and [Bekhorot 10b](https://www.sefaria.org/Bekhorot.10b.2): Rabbi Yose said, “Nimos, brother of Rabbi Yehoshua HaGarsi, told me that one who slaughters a raven,” etc.[^2]

notes.text: [Eruvin](https://www.sefaria.org/Eruvin.21b.12) identifies Rabbi Yehoshua HaGarsi as the attendant of Rabbi Akiva in prison.
The linked Bekhorot names Nimos, brother of Rabbi Yehoshua HaGarsi. The Tosefta gives Inumos, brother of Yehoshua HaBarsi, in the corresponding ruling.
